title: SaaS / Hive services
text: Fleet health, calibration status, software distribution and device configuration governance.
Multi-site result aggregation and role-based collaboration.
Central model registry with signed packages, staged rollout and rollback.
De-identified surveillance analytics only under appropriate governance and data-sharing agreements.
Remote support with explicit consent, session logging and least-privilege access.
tables:
SAAS IS ADDITIVE
Cloud services extend collaboration and fleet management. They are not allowed to silently change a reportable result, generate breakpoints, or make core operation dependent on a live internet connection.
